A Negative Wage on a Contract

User manual · English · 7 steps
Learn what the contract form does with a negative wage, without saving anything.

1. Open Employees

Open the Employees app.

2. Employees menu

Open the Employees menu.

3. Contracts

Click Contracts.

4. New

Click New to start a contract.

5. Type a negative wage

Type -500, then press Tab.

6. Check the wage

Look at the wage. Click the field to continue.

7. Discard

Click the discard icon to leave without saving.
